title: Lambda Architecture – Unified View
description: Merges batch layer (lambda_batch) with speed layer (lambda_speed) for a complete picture.

panels.title: Revenue per Hour
panels.description: Historical hours from batch layer parquets, most recent hours from speed layer live events.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "revenue_per_hour")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "revenue")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with layer: "batch" }))

from(bucket: "lambda_speed")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sales")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with layer: "speed" }))

from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "revenue_per_day")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "revenue")

panels.title: Events per Hour
panels.description: Count of all events. Batch covers historical hours; speed covers live data.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "events_per_hour")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "event_count")

from(bucket: "lambda_speed")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sales")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "quantity")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "events_by_type")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "lambda_speed")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sales")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "quantity")
  |> group(columns: ["event_type"])
  |> count()

panels.title: Top Products by Revenue
panels.description: Real-time aggregation from speed layer. Complements batch top-products-by-qty.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lambda_speed")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sales")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> group(columns: ["product_id"])
  |> sum()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)

from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "top_products_by_qty")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total_qty")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "funnel_counts")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "count")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "funnel_ratios")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()

panels.title: AOV – Average Order Value
panels.description: Batch = historical AOV. Speed = live AOV from recent events.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aov")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avg_order_value")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "lambda_speed")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sales")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "lambda_batch")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "top_users")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total_events")
  |> last()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

panels.title: Top Active Users (Speed – live last window)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "lambda_speed")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sales")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "quantity")
  |> group(columns: ["user_id"])
  |> count()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
